description: Marketing content and business planning workflows for OM Mentor members.

interface.longDescription: OM Studio Assistants helps OM Mentor members complete marketing and business tasks in ChatGPT, including drafting posts and headlines, planning campaigns, defining customer profiles, and writing short-video scripts. It retrieves specialized assistant workflows and reference materials from the OM Studio server to guide these tasks. An account with Active OM Studio access is required. Members sign in with their registered Google account.
